traces.title: Erna-Berger-Straße watchtower
traces.todayText: One of the last watchtowers of its type survives here and is protected as a listed monument.

traces.title: Tränenpalast at Friedrichstraße
traces.todayText: The former Friedrichstraße border-crossing building now hosts the Tränenpalast permanent exhibition at the historic site.

traces.title: Schlesischer Busch command post
traces.todayText: The former command post survives in Schlesischer Park; the tower and a nearby slab-wall section are documented as historic monuments.

traces.title: Günter Litfin Memorial at Kieler Eck
traces.todayText: The preserved former command-post tower is home to a memorial for Günter Litfin, one of the first victims of the Berlin Wall.

traces.title: East Side Gallery at Oberbaumbrücke
traces.todayText: A long surviving section of the former Hinterlandmauer is known today as the East Side Gallery between Ostbahnhof and Oberbaumbrücke.
